suggested_fix: No fix required. The function checks kvm_has_gicv3() before dispatching SGIs and injects UNDEF otherwise, so a guest without a GICv3 cannot reach vgic_v3_dispatch_sgi() with uninitialized vGICv3 state. Reads of these write-only registers go to read_from_write_only(), and every Op1/Op2 encoding sets g1 to a defined value.
